Title: Real-Time Health Dashboard
Description: Display bearing health scores for all machines on the factory floor with live updates every 5 seconds
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows live data; health scores update automatically; no manual refresh needed

Title: Health Status Indicators
Description: Color-coded health indicators (Green/Yellow/Red) for each bearing based on vibration and temperature thresholds
Acceptance Criteria: Green: normal operation; Yellow: warning threshold crossed; Red: critical failure imminent

Title: Bearing Detail Drilldown
Description: Click on any bearing to see vibration spectrum, temperature trend chart, and predicted remaining useful life
Acceptance Criteria: Detail view loads within 1 second; shows last 30 days of trend data

Title: Multi-Plant View
Description: Support switching between multiple factory sites in a single interface
Acceptance Criteria: Operators can switch plants via dropdown; data loads within 2 seconds

Title: Role-Based Access Control
Description: Implement RBAC: Plant Manager sees all machines; Operator sees only assigned production line
Acceptance Criteria: Roles enforced at API level; unauthorized access returns 403

Title: Sensor Data Ingestion
Description: Ingest MQTT sensor data at 10000+ readings per second with sub-second latency
Acceptance Criteria: Pipeline handles peak load without data loss; latency < 500ms p99

Title: Time-Series Storage
Description: Store raw sensor data in Azure Data Explorer with 90-day hot retention
Acceptance Criteria: Queries on last 90 days complete within 3 seconds

Title: Cold Storage Archival
Description: Auto-archive data older than 90 days to Azure Blob cold tier
Acceptance Criteria: Archival runs nightly; archived data retrievable within 4 hours

Title: Data Quality Validation
Description: Reject malformed or out-of-range sensor readings before ML processing
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid readings logged and quarantined; valid data rate > 99.5%

Title: RUL Prediction Model
Description: Predict remaining useful life of bearings using vibration and temperature patterns
Acceptance Criteria: Model accuracy > 85% on test set; predictions update hourly

Title: Anomaly Detection
Description: Detect unusual bearing behavior patterns that precede failures
Acceptance Criteria: False positive rate < 5%; detection within 15 minutes of anomaly onset

Title: Monthly Model Retraining
Description: Automated monthly retraining pipeline using latest operational data
Acceptance Criteria: Retraining completes within 4 hours; auto-validates against baseline

Title: A/B Model Testing
Description: Run two ML models in parallel and compare prediction accuracy
Acceptance Criteria: Side-by-side comparison dashboard; statistical significance testing

Title: Configurable Alert Thresholds
Description: Different alert thresholds per machine type and bearing model
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can configure thresholds via UI; changes take effect within 1 minute

Title: Push Notifications
Description: Send mobile push notifications when bearing health drops below warning threshold
Acceptance Criteria: Notification delivered within 30 seconds of threshold breach

Title: SMS and Email for Critical Alerts
Description: Trigger SMS and email for Red status critical alerts to maintenance supervisor
Acceptance Criteria: SMS delivered within 1 minute; email within 2 minutes

Title: Alert Logging and Acknowledgment
Description: Log all alerts with timestamps; track operator acknowledgment
Acceptance Criteria: Full audit trail; acknowledgment status visible in dashboard

Title: Escalation Workflow
Description: Auto-escalate unacknowledged alerts to plant manager after 30 minutes
Acceptance Criteria: Escalation triggers notification to manager; logged in system

Title: SAP PM Work Order Generation
Description: Auto-generate SAP PM maintenance work orders from acknowledged alerts
Acceptance Criteria: Work order includes machine ID bearing ID failure mode and recommended action

Title: Work Order Feedback Loop
Description: Feed completed work order outcomes back into ML model as ground truth
Acceptance Criteria: Feedback data available for next retraining cycle

Title: Monthly Reliability Reports
Description: Generate MTBF prediction accuracy and cost savings reports
Acceptance Criteria: Reports available by 2nd business day of each month

Title: Report Export
Description: Export reports as PDF and Excel formats
Acceptance Criteria: Downloads complete within 10 seconds for reports up to 50 pages

Title: System Health Admin Dashboard
Description: Show data pipeline throughput model inference latency and API response times
Acceptance Criteria: Real-time metrics with 1-minute granularity

Title: Performance SLA
Description: Dashboard loads within 2 seconds for up to 500 simultaneous users
Acceptance Criteria: Load tested and verified at 500 concurrent users

Title: High Availability
Description: 99.9% uptime with multi-region deployment and automatic failover
Acceptance Criteria: Failover completes within 60 seconds; no data loss

Title: Security Compliance
Description: Encryption at rest and in transit; ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance
Acceptance Criteria: Security audit passed; penetration test completed

Title: Scalability
Description: Support 50 factories and 100000 bearings without architecture changes
Acceptance Criteria: Performance benchmarks met at full scale
